Many individuals present with iron-deﬁ ciency anemia and 
the screening for other conditions such as thyroid disease, 
chronic fatigue, constipation, and irritable bowel syndrome 
has resulted in an increased rate of diagnosis. Catassi et al. 
used the following as criteria for screening for CD: positive
family history, chronic fatigue, unexplained anemia, abnor-
mal liver function, autoimmune disorders, Down’s syndrome, 
Turner’s syndrome, infertility, and epilepsy/ataxia.16 Using this 
criteria, the authors revealed a 43-fold increase in the rate of 
diagnosis.
